results.text:
When people realize that AI is simply the newest technological tool and not the world-shattering catastrophe of artificial life they seem to believe, we’ll all be better off. Then we can focus on how to use it well, and prevent poor usage of it. 

Panic over nuclear weapons and power was the same. 

So were automobiles. And factories.

They’re. Just. Tools.

And while it’s easier to make “maybe good sounding” music than it was, it’s also a pathway for people who couldn’t do it the old ways to find their niche. 

There is a massive amount of AI slop in the world. Huuuuuge amounts. 

The answer isn’t abandoning AI, it’s for us as humans to become more discerning.
